feature_values: semantic kind prefix + rendered exact scalar or (Kind,Doc,Sentence,Slot); lexicographic dictionary; raw finite Any is distinct from All
features: unary raw rows; owner/source/label rectangles expanded and their target sets unioned; All target dominates; semantic dictionary ids; same canonical columns/order as C3
signed_graph: all original clauses, including patient nodes; sort by source path then original ordinal; map signed CSR rows to canonical ids; growth=false; SCC diagnostic groups sorted as sets of canonical ids
base_growth: every independent source-hint closure and constructor/output edge; remove only the additional scalar leaf node 0 and edges to it from census comparison; publish scalar edges separately; all such edges still checked against ranks
final_nodes: every complete mixed semantic (origin,tag-tuple) or arithmetic-site/tag node; raw, never source-restricted; scalar leaf normalization alone
final_projected_edges: if restricted refinement: keep a complete mixed edge exactly when its source projects to a base SCC with a cycle; Skolem projects through the semantic template origin, arithmetic through original clause+goal; predicate evaluated on independent base graph after base-object parity; base/full-refinement modes keep every source
final_complete_edges: all non-scalar mixed edges, compared both ways with --redesign --dump-analysis --dump-full-mixed, whose only algorithm delta is existing build_k1 instead of for_sources in the restricted branch; filter and projection check unchanged
outcome: mode, checked admission, checked full-refinement flag, semantic registry size, original-mapped variant count, refined-template count, projected edge/projection-check count
reachability: query roots from the checked provider; separate BFS reads canonical signed-edge bytes, adds selected-document metadata, maps back to original ids; exact equality with actual provider selection
x100: F1b-g100-s1 correctness run compares signed original nodes/edges/SCC and projected growth/outcome against C3x-ad; feature flattening, complete-mixed oracle at x100 and query-answer acquisition remain separate named limits
